parameters.content:
## Pest Lead Agent: handle Approve / Hold from Slack

A manager clicks **Approve** or **Hold** on a lead summary in #leads. Slack sends the click over Socket Mode to the local relay (`slack-relay/relay.mjs`), which acks it at once and POSTs **ids only** here, signed like the lead webhook (SLACK_RELAY_SECRET). Only users on SLACK_APPROVER_IDS may decide (empty list: nobody). The first decision per lead wins in the event ledger; a repeat click or a Slack redelivery changes nothing. The ledger also hands back the deal, task and message ids the lead run stored, so nothing from the button is trusted beyond the event id.

**Steps**: read the stage ids from the ops rules sheet, HubSpot deal Needs approval to Approved or On hold, a comment on the ClickUp CSR task, and chat.update on the original message (buttons replaced by who decided and when). Writes carry Idempotency-Key = event id + node name and X-Run-Id; 3 retries 5 seconds apart. Failures go to "Pest Lead Agent · Alert on errors", which also releases the decision claim.
Signed by the relay (HMAC over timestamp.rawBody, 300 s window): 401 otherwise. Ids only, in a fixed shape: 400 otherwise. Both exit with no side effects.
SLACK_APPROVER_IDS decides who may act. Anyone else gets an ephemeral notice and nothing changes.
The event ledger holds one decision per lead: first wins. A decided or in-flight lead answers already_decided; a lead that never needed approval answers 409.
Settings from the ops rules sheet (the HubSpot stage ids live there), then deal stage, CSR task comment, Slack message update, and the ledger marks the decision done.

nodes.name: Receive Slack action
nodes.notes: Production webhook POST /webhook/ridgeway/slack-action, called only by the local Socket Mode relay. Keeps the raw body.

nodes.name: Verify relay signature
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp.rawBody with SLACK_RELAY_SECRET, timing-safe, 300 s window. Same check as the lead webhook.

nodes.name: Check relay signature result
nodes.notes: Early exit: a bad or missing signature ends the run here with no side effects.

nodes.name: Respond 401 unauthorized
nodes.notes: Answers 401. Nothing was called.

nodes.name: Validate Slack action
nodes.notes: Ids only: team, action (approve_lead or hold_lead), event id, user, channel, message ts, action ts, retry attempt. Anything else is refused.

nodes.name: Check action is valid
nodes.notes: Early exit: a malformed payload ends the run here.

nodes.name: Respond 400 invalid
nodes.notes: Answers 400 with the validation errors. Nothing was called.

nodes.name: Check approver
nodes.notes: Is the Slack user on SLACK_APPROVER_IDS? An empty list means nobody: fail closed.

nodes.name: Branch on approver
nodes.notes: Approvers go on to claim the decision; anyone else only gets an ephemeral notice.

nodes.name: Prepare approver notice
nodes.notes: Ephemeral text for the person who clicked: only approvers can decide.

nodes.name: Post Slack approver notice
nodes.notes: chat.postEphemeral, seen only by that user. Non-critical. Nothing else changes.

nodes.name: Respond not an approver
nodes.notes: Answers 403 {status: not_approver}.

nodes.name: Prepare decision claim
nodes.notes: Builds the decision claim: decision, user, click time and this execution id.

nodes.name: Claim decision
nodes.notes: Event ledger: the first decision on a lead wins. Returns the deal, task and message ids the lead run stored. Critical.

nodes.name: Check decision claim
nodes.notes: claimed goes on; a decided or in-flight lead (repeat click, Slack redelivery) and an unknown lead stop here.

nodes.name: Route decision claim
nodes.notes: Early exit for anything but a fresh claim, with no vendor call.

nodes.name: Respond already decided
nodes.notes: Answers 200 {status: already_decided}. No second update.

nodes.name: Respond not awaiting approval
nodes.notes: Answers 409: the event is unknown to the ledger or never needed approval.

nodes.name: Fetch ops settings
nodes.notes: Reads the Settings tab of the ops rules sheet: the HubSpot stage ids live there.

nodes.name: Prepare deal decision
nodes.notes: Deal stage from the decision and the sheet: Approved or On hold. The deal id comes from the ledger, not from the button.

nodes.name: Move deal to decided stage
nodes.notes: PATCH the HubSpot deal stage. Idempotency-Key per event and node. Critical.

nodes.name: Prepare ClickUp decision comment
nodes.notes: Comment for the CSR task: who decided, when, and what to do next. Ids only.

nodes.name: Add ClickUp decision comment
nodes.notes: POST a comment on the CSR task the lead run created. Idempotency-Key per event and node. Critical.

nodes.name: Prepare Slack message update
nodes.notes: Rebuilds the summary from the blocks the ledger kept, without the buttons, plus who decided and when.

nodes.name: Update Slack approval message
nodes.notes: chat.update on the original message: the buttons are replaced. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Prepare decision done
nodes.notes: Records whether the Slack update worked and builds the done mark for the ledger.

nodes.name: Mark decision done
nodes.notes: Tells the ledger the decision is complete, so a repeat click answers already_decided. Non-critical.

nodes.name: Respond with decision
nodes.notes: Answers 200 {status: approved | on_hold}.
